title: SARS-CoV-2 variant-call VCF regression fixture
kind: demonstration and regression fixture containing observed variant calls

provenance.status: observed data transformed into a regression fixture
provenance.description: The header states VCFv4.2, reference NC_045512v2, and source faToVcf refPlus.unmapped.aligned.fasta. The original callset/source and transformation history beyond that header are not identified.

biological_context.experimental_units: 12 SARS-CoV-2 sample columns; header exposes sample labels with country/lab or accession-like strings and dates. Study design is not established here.
biological_context.assay: Variant calls represented in VCF; upstream assay/calling procedure unknown.
biological_context.design: Regression subset, not shown to be a representative cohort.
metadata: 12 sample labels, some dates and accession-like identifiers

assets.processing_stage: small variant-call input fixture for vcfFilter regressions; header says generated by faToVcf from refPlus.unmapped.aligned.fasta
assets.relationship: source fixture; no parent callset asset identified

access_and_terms.access_requirements: Publicly readable through GitHub at the cited revision.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown. Repository README says licensing differs by directory; no data-specific reuse permission was checked.
sources: repository README at pinned revision describes directory-dependent licensing
fixture VCF header and GitHub path

inspection.checked: Inspected the VCF header and bounded preview plus vcfFilter regression makefile and implementation; no file downloaded separately beyond bounded source response.
unverified: full contents, original source callset/accession, sample-study relationship, upstream assay, and redistribution eligibility

limitations: Treat as a software fixture, not a cohort for scientific prevalence inference.
Do not infer a publication, study design, or license from sample identifiers or public repository availability.

title: SARS-CoV-2 selected exclusion/masking site VCF fixture
kind: annotation fixture used as an exclusion list

provenance.status: adapted selection of sites; exact curator and selection workflow unknown
provenance.description: The file comment says it was hacked down to a few records by Angie and cites a SARS-CoV-2 masking-strategies discussion. It is used by the vcfFilter regression recipe as positional exclusions.

biological_context.design: Selected coordinate/allele exclusions with mask/caution annotations; not a measured specimen dataset.
metadata: substitution and ambiguity/exclusion rationale tags in INFO

assets.relationship: independent site annotations applied by matching CHROM/POS against the variant-call fixture

assets.processing_stage: cited discussion; not inspected during this pass
assets.relationship: file comment cites this as masking-strategy context; exact records-to-source mapping not established

access_and_terms.access_requirements: Publicly readable through GitHub; cited external discussion URL is public-facing.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown; repository data terms and external discussion reuse terms not verified.
sources: exclude.vcf header comments and pinned GitHub path

inspection.checked: Inspected header and bounded record preview; file comment and vcfFilter regression makefile identify use as -excludeVcf input.
unverified: complete record inventory, authorship, curation method, scope of cited discussion, and redistribution eligibility

limitations: Positions are used as exclusions regardless of REF/ALT because vcfFilter matches CHROM and POS only.
Should not be presented as a validated clinical/pathogenicity annotation set.
